name: Delete Search
description: Searches current soft-deleted resources. The operation supports system-level and resource-type-level invocation and filters only by the resource last-updated time.

parameter.name: _since
parameter.documentation: An inclusive lower bound on the soft-deleted resource's last-updated time.

parameter.name: _before
parameter.documentation: An exclusive upper bound on the soft-deleted resource's last-updated time.

parameter.name: _count
parameter.documentation: The maximum number of soft-deleted resources to return in one page.

parameter.name: _continuationToken
parameter.documentation: The continuation token used to retrieve the next page.

parameter.name: _sort
parameter.documentation: The result order. Only _lastUpdated and -_lastUpdated are supported.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: A history bundle containing current soft-deleted resources.
